description: This file contains unit tests for the AuthProviderChain class in the OrangeHRM authentication system. It tests the behavior of the chain of authentication providers, including adding providers, resolving authentication through multiple providers based on priority, and handling conflicts when adding providers with duplicate priorities or instances.

classes.name: AuthProviderChainTest
classes.description: Unit test class for AuthProviderChain, testing provider addition, authentication flow, and exception handling.

classes.name: DebugAuthProvider
classes.description: Mock implementation of an authentication provider with configurable priority for testing.

classes.name: LocalAuthProvider
classes.description: Mock implementation of a local authentication provider used in tests.

classes.name: LDAPAuthProvider
classes.description: Mock implementation of an LDAP authentication provider used in tests.

methods.name: testAuthenticateWithOneProvider
methods.description: Tests authentication with a single provider in the chain.

methods.name: testAuthenticateWithMultipleProvidersResolvingFirstProvider
methods.description: Tests authentication flow resolving to the first provider based on priority.

methods.name: testAuthenticateWithMultipleProvidersResolvingSecondProvider
methods.description: Tests authentication flow resolving to the second provider based on priority.

methods.name: testAuthenticateWithMultipleProvidersResolvingLastProvider
methods.description: Tests authentication flow resolving to the last provider when others fail.

methods.name: testAddProviderWithMultipleProvidersWithSamePriority
methods.description: Verifies that adding providers with duplicate priorities throws an exception.

methods.name: testAddProvider
methods.description: Tests adding a new provider and handling duplicate instance exception.
